name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 15 – Am 53
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 15. Urges the EU and its Member States to stand firmly on the side of Ukraine; recalls its conviction that it is on the Ukrainian battlefields that the future of Europe will be decided and that the trajectory of Russia’s war against Ukraine will be decisively shifted; underlines that such a shift now depends almost entirely on Europe; urges the Member States, therefore, to provide more arms and ammunition to Ukraine before negotiations are concluded; warns that, if the EU were to fail in its support and Ukraine were forced to surrender, Russia would then turn against other countries, including possibly the EU Member States; calls on the EU Member States, international partners and NATO allies to lift all restrictions on the use of Western weapons systems delivered to Ukraine against military targets in Russian territory; calls for the EU and its Member States to actively work towards maintaining and achieving the broadest possible international support for Ukraine and identifying a peaceful solution to the war that must be based on full respect for Ukraine’s independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, the principles of international law, accountability for war crimes and the crime of aggression, and Russian payments for the massive damage caused in Ukraine; urges the EU and its Member States to participate in establishing robust future security guarantees for Ukraine; urges the EU and its Member States to support international law and the rules-based world order without hesitation; recalls, in this regard, the ongoing investigation into the atrocities carried out by Israel against the Palestinian population; underlines how international law is fundamental to European security; reiterates its support for the ICJ, the International Criminal Court and other international bodies in investigating crimes against humanity and war crimes;
